title: Calamity Strikes
subtitle: A Quiet Morning Unravels Dark Motives
summary: Byomkesh Bakshi’s uneventful morning is jolted by curious advertisements and cryptic notices, hinting at secrets lurking beneath the mundane. When suspicion stirs over innocuous classifieds, a tangled mystery begins to unfold—one only a sharp mind can unravel. Dive into a world where even the ordinary hides the seeds of intrigue.
